long_biography.plain_text:
At IBM's Thomas J. Watson Research Center, Robert Mercer worked on probabilistic speech recognition, large language models and statistical machine translation. The Association for Computational Linguistics later recognised that work with its lifetime achievement award.

In 1993 Mercer and fellow IBM researcher Peter Brown moved to Renaissance Technologies. They helped refine the firm's equity-trading models, applying a research culture built around statistics, computing and large datasets. Mercer rose to co-chief executive after founder James Simons retired and remained in that position until the end of 2017. He then left the board and returned to a technical research role. Because Mercer joined the already-established firm, his relationship to the fortune-producing platform is that of a senior operator and investor rather than founder.
long_biography.html:
At IBM's Thomas J. Watson Research Center, Robert Mercer worked on probabilistic speech recognition, large language models and statistical machine translation. The Association for Computational Linguistics later recognised that work with its lifetime achievement award.

In 1993 Mercer and fellow IBM researcher Peter Brown moved to Renaissance Technologies. They helped refine the firm's equity-trading models, applying a research culture built around statistics, computing and large datasets. Mercer rose to co-chief executive after founder James Simons retired and remained in that position until the end of 2017. He then left the board and returned to a technical research role. Because Mercer joined the already-established firm, his relationship to the fortune-producing platform is that of a senior operator and investor rather than founder.
